title: Spicy Smoky Veggie Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and nutritious stir fry made with smoky and spicy flavors. This dish is perfect as a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Heat the stir fry oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the cumin and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the bell peppers and cook for 3-4 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the sweet potatoes and cook for another 4-5 minutes, until they are tender.
Add the kale and stir fry for 2-3 minutes, until it is wilted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
